messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Metformin is a first-line treatment used for type 2 diabetes.
It is used in adults and children 10 years and older.
It helps improve blood sugar levels.
It is also used off-label to improve symptoms of polycystic ovarian syndrome (PCOS) and other conditions.
Metformin tablets should be used together with dietary changes and exercise for better results.
Metformin belongs to the drug class biguanides.
Metformin works by reducing glucose absorption from the intestines.
It works by lowering liver glucose production.
It works by improving insulin sensitivity.
Managing blood sugar levels with medications like metformin can prevent diabetes complications.
These complications include kidney damage, nerve issues, blindness, amputations, and sexual dysfunction.
Managing blood sugar levels with medications like metformin can lower the risk of cardiovascular disease.

In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
B. 'applies to patients who are to be managed with': The subject drug is used for patients who are to be managed with the procedure or treatment specified by the object entity.
C. 'has use indication': The subject drug may be used for the medical purpose or indication specified by the object entity.
D. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
